name: Grand Palace
desc: Gold on gold on gold — it glitters so hard sunglasses count as gear. Save up; this is Bangkok's crown jewel, literally.

name: Wat Pho
desc: Home of the 46-meter reclining Buddha whose feet alone are artworks. Also the birthplace of Thai massage. Bliss on a budget.

name: Wat Arun
desc: The riverside spire that owns every Bangkok sunset. Cross by ferry for pennies, climb the steep steps, feel epic.

name: Chatuchak Weekend Market
desc: Fifteen thousand stalls of things you never knew you needed. Entry is free; leaving with an empty wallet is a personal choice.

name: Lumphini Park
desc: Bangkok's green escape, patrolled by giant monitor lizards that fear absolutely nothing. Free aerobics at dusk if you're brave.

name: Khao San Road
desc: Backpacker Broadway: bucket drinks, pad thai carts, questionable tattoos. You come to people-watch; you stay till 3 a.m.

name: Jim Thompson House
desc: A silk tycoon's teakwood house-museum wrapped in jungle garden. He vanished mysteriously; the calm here never does.

name: Yaowarat (Chinatown)
desc: Neon canyons and sidewalk woks after dark. The best meal of your life is under three dollars here — the hard part is choosing.

name: Mahanakhon SkyWalk
desc: A glass floor 78 stories up, for standing over Bangkok like you own it. Someday-splurge material; screenshot the skyline till then.
